lines.en: label shrine35:
scene black
scene nightsky
Night comes before I know it.
lines.zh: 夜幕在我察觉之前就降临了。

lines.en: I feel like I decided to visit the shrine just a few minutes ago-
lines.zh: 感觉上，我像是几分钟前才决定来神社的——

lines.en: But the sun was shining then. And this is certainly no sun I know.
lines.zh: 可那时候还阳光明媚。而现在天上这个，肯定不是我认识的那个太阳。

lines.en: I make my way down the streets of the city, staring up at the sky and hoping to catch a glimpse of a supernova.
lines.zh: 我沿着城市的街道往前走，抬头望着天空，希望能瞥见一颗超新星。

lines.en: The thing is, viewing a supernova from all the way down here wouldn’t be nearly as exciting as seeing it up close.
lines.zh: 问题是，从这么远的地方观看超新星，远不如凑近了看来得震撼。

lines.en: I know this for a fact.
lines.zh: 这一点我清楚得很。

lines.en: Because I viewed a supernova just the other day.
lines.zh: 因为就在前几天，我刚看过一次超新星。

lines.en: scene imissyou11
scene nightsky
What a beautiful explosion that was.
lines.zh: 那是一场多么美丽的爆炸啊。

lines.en: I wish I could remember more of it.
lines.zh: 真希望我能多记住一些。

lines.en: I’m not allowed to remember, though.
lines.zh: 可我不被允许记住。

lines.en: Maya says that if I do, I might disappear.
lines.zh: Maya 说，如果我记住了，我说不定会消失。

lines.en: I don’t want to disappear yet.
lines.zh: 我还不想消失。

lines.en: I have so much left to do...
lines.zh: 我还有那么多事没做……

lines.en: If only there was someone around to guide me.
lines.zh: 要是身边有谁能引导我就好了。

lines.en: I say that as if I expect someone to just show up and do it.
lines.zh: 我说这话，倒像是期待有人会突然出现来做这件事似的。

lines.en: That’s not how this works, though.
lines.zh: 可事情不是这么运作的。

lines.en: The closest I have to a guide at all right now is the one I need guiding {i}to{/i}.
lines.zh: 而现在我最接近的引导者，恰恰正是我需要被引导着{i}走向{/i}的那个人。

lines.en: For I’ve somehow found myself lost. Wandering around in the middle of the night with a destination in mind but not enough willpower to arrive there.
lines.zh: 因为不知怎么，我迷路了。半夜三更在外面游荡，心里有个目的地，却没有足够的意志力抵达那里。

lines.en: I begin to think of the things I will say if I do.
lines.zh: 我开始想着，如果真到了那里，我该说些什么。

lines.en: “Hello. I retract my rejection of coitus. Come, Maya. Let us repopulate the world with more people who can travel through time.”
lines.zh: “你好。我撤回我对性交的拒绝。来吧，Maya。让我们用更多能穿越时空的人重新填满这个世界。”

lines.en: How ridiculous.
lines.zh: 真是荒唐。

lines.en: Though I suppose the sheer idea of our existence in and of itself is ridiculous in a multitude of ways.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，光是我们存在这件事本身，就在诸多意义上荒唐透顶。

lines.en: It is not poor luck, though. Which is how I’m sure she would describe it.
lines.zh: 但这不是运气不好。虽然她多半会这么形容。

lines.en: It is a blessing.
lines.zh: 这是恩赐。

lines.en: We can see everything.
lines.zh: 我们能看到一切。

lines.en: Why should I be punished for not closing my eyes?
lines.zh: 我凭什么要因为不肯闭上眼睛而受罚？

lines.en: scene black
I walk.
lines.zh: 我走。

lines.en: And I walk.
lines.zh: 接着走。

lines.en: And I walk and I walk and I walk.
lines.zh: 我走啊走啊走啊走。

lines.en: And I find something new.
lines.zh: 然后我发现了新东西。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine1
: Sensei? What are you doing here this late?
lines.zh: : Sensei？这么晚了你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I could ask the same question to all of you.
lines.zh: : 这话我也可以问你们三个。

lines.en: : We came here to get Maya since we were all supposed to hang out tonight.
lines.zh: : 我们是来接 Maya 的，因为今晚说好要一起玩。

lines.en: : You’re not suddenly religious...are you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你该不会突然信教了吧……Sensei？

lines.en: : Me? No. I was just wandering around.
lines.zh: : 我？没有。我只是到处瞎逛。

lines.en: : I came up here because it’s usually warm. Apparently that’s not the case tonight, though.
lines.zh: : 我上来是因为这儿平时暖和。不过看来今晚不是这么回事。
: 天开始……

lines.en: : It started snowing a couple hours ago.
lines.zh: : 几个小时前开始下雪了。

lines.en: : Just after the sunset.
lines.zh: : 就在日落之后。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : Well if you three are planning on hanging out tonight, I can just head back.
lines.zh: : 既然你们三个今晚打算一起玩，那我就先回去吧。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine2
: What? No! Come with us!
lines.zh: : 什么？不行！跟我们一起来！

lines.en: : Where were you before this? It was probably a really long walk and...you don’t even have a real jacket.
lines.zh: : 你之前在哪儿？那大概走了很远的路，而且……你连件像样的外套都没穿。

lines.en: : We’re going out to a family restaurant. I can pay for you if you don’t have any money.
lines.zh: : 我们要去一家家庭餐厅。你没钱的话我可以替你付。

lines.en: : I’m not broke, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我没破产，Ayane。

lines.en: : Yes, but I’m rich. So I really insist that you come with us.
lines.zh: : 是，但我有钱。所以我真的坚持要你一起来。

lines.en: : Let me treat you and get you out of the cold.
lines.zh: : 让我请客，让你别再挨冻。

lines.en: : Yeah! Come on. Let’s get you somewhere warm.
lines.zh: : 对呀！走吧。我们找个暖和的地方。

lines.en: : I...agree...
: You should probably come with us.
lines.zh: : 你大概该跟我们一起来。

lines.en: : Why is everyone so concerned with warming me up all of a sudden? I feel fine.
lines.zh: : 怎么突然所有人都这么操心要把我捂热？我觉得挺好的啊。

lines.en: : I’m just bored.
lines.zh: : 我只是无聊而已。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine3
: You’re soaking wet.
lines.zh: : 你浑身都湿透了。

lines.en: : Which is...worrying since it’s not even snowing that hard.
lines.zh: : 这可……让人担心，因为雪下得并不算大。

lines.en: : Yeah. Your hair is basically all white right now. You look like a cool grandpa.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你的头发现在基本上全白了。你看起来像个很酷的老爷爷。

lines.en: : If this is how you will look when you are old, I am even more excited for our future than I already was.
lines.zh: : 如果你老了之后是这副模样，那我对我们的未来比原先还要期待了。

lines.en: I pat down my pants and blazer to find that, yes, they are soaking wet.
lines.zh: 我拍了拍裤子和西装外套，发现——是的，它们确实湿透了。

lines.en: But when did this even happen? And why did I not realize anything until it was pointed out?
lines.zh: 可这到底是什么时候的事？为什么直到被人点破我才察觉？

lines.en: The three girls stare at me, unsure of how to proceed with the conversation given that I likely look insane right about now.
lines.zh: 三个女孩盯着我，不知道该怎么把对话继续下去，因为我现在这副样子大概像疯了。

lines.en: And, you know, maybe I am?
lines.zh: 而且，说实话，也许我就是疯了呢？

lines.en: I’d certainly pass that judgement onto anyone I saw casually walking around in soaking wet clothes during a minor snowstorm.
lines.zh: 我肯定会把同样的判断加在任何一个在小雪天里穿着湿透的衣服漫不经心散步的人身上。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t think just standing here is going to do anyone good.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我觉得就这么干站着对谁都没好处。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine4
: Should we maybe...call an ambulance or something?
lines.zh: : 我们要不要……叫辆救护车什么的？

lines.en: : What? No. He’ll be fine. Sensei never gets colds.
lines.zh: : 什么？不用。他不会有事的。Sensei 从来不感冒。

lines.en: : He just gets like this sometimes. Once we get him home and into bed he’ll be as good as new.
lines.zh: : 他只是偶尔会变成这样。等我们把他弄回家塞进被窝，他就会跟新的一样。

lines.en: : Okay, you two realize I can hear you, right?
lines.zh: : 喂，你们两个知道我听得到吧？

lines.en: : I’m perfectly fine.
lines.zh: : 我好得很。

lines.en: : Besides, I already offered to go home since you’re busy.
lines.zh: : 再说，你们有事要忙，我已经说过要回去了。

lines.en: : Making a big deal out of it is just going to make me feel weird.
lines.zh: : 把这事闹得那么大，只会让我觉得很别扭。

lines.en: : See, Ayane? No ambulance necessary. In fact-
lines.zh: : 看到了吧，Ayane？不需要救护车。事实上——

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine5
: Sensei, I’m going to walk home with you and make sure you’re okay. Ayane and Maya can go out to eat by themselves.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我要陪你走回家，确认你没事。Ayane 和 Maya 可以自己去吃饭。

lines.en: : Actually...why don’t we just get something delivered to your house?
lines.zh: : 其实……我们干脆叫外卖送到你家不行吗？

lines.en: : I’m suddenly losing my appetite anyway.
lines.zh: : 我突然也没什么胃口了。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine6
: Would it be okay if I spoke to him alone for a moment?
lines.zh: : 我能单独跟他说一会儿话吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Really?
lines.zh: : 哈？真的假的？

lines.en: : But you never want to talk to Sensei.
lines.zh: : 可你从来都不想跟 Sensei 说话啊。

lines.en: : And I’m not saying I want to talk to him now either.
lines.zh: : 我也没说我现在就想跟他说。

lines.en: : Then why-
lines.zh: : 那为什么——

lines.en: : Do you want to talk to Maya, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你想跟 Maya 说话吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind that.
lines.zh: : 我不介意。

lines.en: : I think there’s something we need to clear up anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我觉得有件事需要说清楚。

lines.en: : What...do you need to clear up, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体……需要说清楚什么？

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine7
: You and Maya? Did something happen that I didn't hear about yet?
lines.zh: : 你和 Maya？发生了什么我还没听说的事吗？

lines.en: : A misunderstanding of sorts.
lines.zh: : 算是某种误会。

lines.en: : It likely won’t take long...but you two can begin heading to Ami’s house or the restaurant or...wherever and then text me to let me know which one you decided on.
lines.zh: : 大概不会花很久……不过你们俩可以先去 Ami 家、或者餐厅、或者……随便哪儿，然后发短信告诉我你们选了哪里。

lines.en: : I’ll make sure Sensei gets there, too.
lines.zh: : 我会确保 Sensei 也过去。

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t have any problem with-
lines.zh: : 我是说……我对此没意见——

lines.en: : I don’t want to leave Sensei’s side right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在不想离开 Sensei 身边。

lines.en: : This all feels very strange.
lines.zh: 这感觉太奇怪了。

lines.en: : It’s fine, Ayane. Really. There’s nothing to worry about.
lines.zh: : 没事的，Ayane。真的。没什么好担心的。

lines.en: : There’s nothing to worry about?
lines.zh: : 没什么好担心的？

lines.en: : You just...wandered over to where Maya hangs out in the middle of the night during a snowstorm to be alone with her and there’s nothing to worry about?
lines.zh: : 你只是……在暴风雪的半夜晃到 Maya 待的地方去跟她独处，然后告诉我没什么好担心的？

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine8
: It’s not like that, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 不是那样的，Ayane……

lines.en: : Ayane, come on. It’s {i}Maya{/i}.
lines.zh: : 行了，Ayane。那可是{i}Maya{/i}。

lines.en: It’s not common that I see Ayane look at anyone this way.
lines.zh: 我不常看到 Ayane 用这种眼神看人。

lines.en: And I’m sure she feels just as strange as I do on account of her resulting silence.
lines.zh: 而我敢肯定，她随之而来的沉默，说明她和我一样觉得别扭。

lines.en: Teenage girls are so fickle, getting upset over small things like this when there’s not even any substance to it.
lines.zh: [teenage] 女孩真是善变，会为这种根本毫无实质的小事闹情绪。

lines.en: Maya and I {i}do{/i} need to clear up a misunderstanding.
lines.zh: Maya 和我{i}确实{/i}需要澄清一个误会。

lines.en: That’s likely why I wound up here in the first place.
lines.zh: 这大概就是我最初晃到这儿来的原因。

lines.en: And it’s a misunderstanding that can’t be brought up around the other two, so-
lines.zh: 而且这个误会没法当着另外两个人的面提起，所以——

lines.en: : We’ll text you in a few minutes to let you know where we’re going.
lines.zh: : 我们过几分钟发短信告诉你我们去哪儿。

lines.en: : Can you {i}not{/i} look so angry while saying that, please? I didn’t even do anything.
lines.zh: : 你能{i}别{/i}用这么生气的表情说这句话吗？我什么都没做啊。

lines.en: : This face just happens out of natural instinct when I think someone is trying to take Sensei away.
lines.zh: : 我一觉得有人想把 Sensei 抢走，这张脸就会出于本能变成这样。

lines.en: : If it makes you feel better, I don’t think you’re going to take Sensei away, Maya.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点的话，我不觉得你会把 Sensei 抢走，Maya。

lines.en: : You’re not girly enough anyway, so I doubt he would even like you like that.
lines.zh: : 反正你也不够女人味，我怀疑他根本不会那样喜欢你。

lines.en: : Oh. Thanks, Ami. That was...kind of you.
lines.zh: : 哦。谢了，Ami。你真是……太体贴了。

lines.en: : Sorry for showing up and making things really awkward when you guys just wanted to get food.
lines.zh: : 抱歉突然冒出来，把你们本来只想吃个饭的局搞得这么尴尬。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine9
: No need to apologize, Sensei! We’re all totally used to working our schedules around you by now anyway.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉，Sensei！反正我们早就把日程围着你转当成习惯了。

lines.en: : I’m sorry if I seemed angry. I’m not.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我看起来像在生气。我没有。

lines.en: : I’ve just been feeling a little strange lately.
lines.zh: : 我只是最近一直觉得有点不对劲。

lines.en: : It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没关系。

lines.en: : I’ll meet up with you guys again in a little while.
lines.zh: : 我过一会儿再去跟你们汇合。

lines.en: : Don’t forget to text me every five minutes so I know you didn’t die of hydrothermopoly.
lines.zh: : 别忘了每五分钟给我发条消息，好让我知道你没死于水热多血症。

lines.en: : Hypothermia. And sure.
lines.zh: : 是失温症。不过好。

lines.en: : See you soon.
lines.zh: : 待会儿见。

lines.en: scene black
Ami and Ayane slowly make their way down the steps of the shrine to avoid slipping and cracking their heads open on the concrete.
lines.zh: Ami 和 Ayane 慢慢走下神社的台阶，免得滑倒把脑袋磕在水泥地上。

lines.en: On the bright side, if one of them {i}did{/i} fall, it would be easy to rip off Maya’s skirt and use it to soak up all of the blood.
lines.zh: 往好处想，要是她们{i}真{/i}有谁摔了，撕下 Maya 的裙子来吸血倒是方便。

lines.en: It’s also the same color, so any stain left would be barely noticeable.
lines.zh: 而且颜色也一样，就算留下污渍也不太看得出来。

lines.en: I bow twice, clap twice, and bow again to prevent any of that from ever happening.
lines.zh: 我拜了两下、拍了两下手、又拜了一下，好让这种事永远不要发生。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine10
: Okay, I’ll talk first.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我先说。

lines.en: : Aren’t you cold in that?
lines.zh: : 你穿成那样不冷吗？

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine11
: At least it’s not soaking wet.
lines.zh: : 至少它没湿透。

lines.en: : There are plenty of warm spots inside of the shrine.
lines.zh: : 神社里头有的是暖和的地方。

lines.en: : You look like you’ve been wandering around for hours.
lines.zh: : 你看起来像已经在外面晃了好几个小时。

lines.en: : I probably was.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : You don’t remember?
lines.zh: : 你不记得？

lines.en: : All I remember is deciding to come here around the same time I always do.
lines.zh: : 我只记得自己和平常差不多的时间决定来这儿。

lines.en: : Then, before I knew it, I was being invited out to eat by a bunch of girls who paint their nails in my living room.
lines.zh: : 然后，等我反应过来，我已经被一群会在我客厅里涂指甲油的女孩邀请去吃饭了。

lines.en: : And that doesn’t worry you?
lines.zh: : 这都不让你担心吗？

lines.en: : Not really. I’m just a little upset that I missed an entire part of the day.
lines.zh: : 不太。我只是有点懊恼，因为我把一整天中的一整段给错过了。

lines.en: : That’s time I will never get back.
lines.zh: : 那是我再也拿不回来的时间。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine12
: Ha ha ha. Time loop humor. Hilarious.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。时间循环的笑话。真好笑。

lines.en: : Well it’s not like you ever laugh at normal humor, so it was worth a shot.
lines.zh: : 反正你从来不会为正常的笑点笑，所以我也就死马当活马医了。

lines.en: : I laugh at plenty of things. You just have the worst sense of humor out of any person I’ve ever encountered.
lines.zh: : 我笑的东西多着呢。只是在我认识的所有人里，你的幽默感是最烂的。

lines.en: It’s cute how she can still insult me while nervously twirling her ribbon around in her fingers.
lines.zh: 她一边紧张地把缎带绕在手指上转，一边还能照样损我，这一点挺可爱的。

lines.en: But I’m sure she has a lot of practice.
lines.zh: 不过我敢肯定，她练得多了。

lines.en: By now, I’m sure the amount of insults I’ve received from this girl add up to around the same total as stars in the sky.
lines.zh: 到如今，我敢说我从这个女孩那儿收到的侮辱，加起来大概跟天上的星星一样多。

lines.en: I’m sure she’d be happy to hear that comparison drawn, but I’m too cold and exhausted to make anyone happy tonight.
lines.zh: 她要是听到这个比喻肯定会高兴，但我今晚又冷又累，没力气哄任何人开心。

lines.en: And...
lines.zh: 而且……

lines.en: There’s still a “misunderstanding” that needs to be cleared up.
lines.zh: 还有一个“误会”需要澄清。

lines.en: : So, about the other night-
lines.zh: : 那么，关于那天晚上——

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine13
: I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : And...I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 而且……对不起。

lines.en: : I was desperate and angry and said some things that should never have been said.
lines.zh: : 我当时又绝望又生气，说了些根本不该说的话。

lines.en: : I’m honestly surprised you’re even here right now.
lines.zh: : 说实话，你现在居然还愿意站在这儿，我都觉得意外。

lines.en: : I was sure you were going to be avoiding me for at least another several weeks.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你至少会再躲我几个星期。

lines.en: : But I suppose that if there is anyone in the world who can so harshly reject a girl only to return and talk about it shortly after, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，如果这世上真有谁能在如此狠狠拒绝一个女孩之后，没过多久又回来谈论这件事，那也就是你了。

lines.en: : Under normal pretenses, I wouldn’t have rejected you at all.
lines.zh: : 在正常情况下，我根本不会拒绝你。

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t even see what happened as a rejection in the first place.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我甚至不觉得那件事算是一次拒绝。

lines.en: : Please, do tell what you saw it as.
lines.zh: : 那请你务必说说看，你觉得那算什么。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if the words ever made it out of my mouth back then, but I didn’t want you doing something like that out of sheer desperation.
lines.zh: : 我不确定当时那些话有没有说出口，但我不想让你纯粹出于绝望去做那种事。

lines.en: : It’s not like that strategy would have worked either way.
lines.zh: 而且那种策略不管怎样也不会奏效。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine14
: I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : Which is why I’m glad you didn’t let me follow through with it.
lines.zh: : 所以我才庆幸你没让我做到底。

lines.en: : Also, if you ever deliriously compare me to a bird again, I will not hesitate to scratch your eyeballs out.
lines.zh: : 还有，你要是再神志不清地把我比作鸟，我会毫不犹豫地把你的眼珠挖出来。

lines.en: : I...did what?
lines.zh: : 我……干了什么？

lines.en: : You said all sorts of strange things as I was frantically trying to get you aroused.
lines.zh: : 我手忙脚乱地想让你兴奋起来的时候，你说了好多奇怪的话。

lines.en: : It was the most embarrassing several minutes of my life.
lines.zh: : 那是我这辈子最尴尬的几分钟。

lines.en: : I have no idea what I’m supposed to say to that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我该对此说什么。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine15
: There’s no need to say anything, really.
lines.zh: : 真的，什么都不用说。

lines.en: : You’ve been having episodes like that since the first loop began.
lines.zh: : 从第一个循环开始，你就一直会有这样的发作。

lines.en: : They just always manifest differently...and get progressively harder to pick up on as we move closer and closer to the middle or the end of a season.
lines.zh: : 只不过它们每次的表现形式都不一样……而且随着我们越来越接近某个季节的中段或末尾，就越来越难察觉。

lines.en: : And is the “middle or the end of a season” getting close now?
lines.zh: : 那现在离“某个季节的中段或末尾”近了吗？

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine14
: I’d say we’re closer to the middle of the middle.
lines.zh: : 我会说，我们大概在中段的中段。

lines.en: : But, then again, everything I know about the world has been slowly fading away since winter began.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，自从入冬以后，我对这个世界所知道的一切都在慢慢褪色。

lines.en: : For all I know, everyone could vanish tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 搞不好所有人明天就会消失。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that’s exactly what you’re hoping for, huh?
lines.zh: : 而我敢肯定，那正是你盼着的事，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes. I’m trying to remain hopeful that it not only buys you more time, but gets rid of the single worst girl I have ever crossed paths with before she can damage you any more.
lines.zh: : 对。我努力保持着希望——希望这不仅给你争取到更多时间，还能在她进一步伤害你之前，让我这辈子遇到过的最糟糕的女孩消失。

lines.en: : She has not “damaged” me, Maya.
lines.zh: : 她没有“伤害”我，Maya。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine16
: Yes she has.
lines.zh: : 她伤害了。

lines.en: : It’s near impossible for you to notice, but I’d like to inform you that, as of right now, I know you a hell of a lot better than you do.
lines.zh: : 你几乎不可能察觉到，但我想告诉你，就目前而言，我了解你的程度比你自己深得多。

lines.en: : So does Noriko, but at least she’s nice about it.
lines.zh: : Noriko 也一样了解你，但至少她说话好听。

lines.en: : Being nice isn’t going to keep you alive.
lines.zh: : 说话好听可保不住你的命。

lines.en: : She’s going to chase you off the same way she did the last time.
lines.zh: : 她会像上次一样把你逼走。

lines.en: : Can you at least tell me what happened “the last time?”
lines.zh: : 你至少能告诉我“上次”发生了什么吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不能。

lines.en: : In fact, the second I tried to tell you something even simpler than that, you passed out on my bed and started hyperventilating.
lines.zh: : 事实上，上次我试图告诉你一件比这更简单的事，你就在我床上昏了过去，开始过度换气。

lines.en: : Well...summarize it or something.
lines.zh: : 那……你概括一下也行啊。

lines.en: : I don’t remember much about that night, but I remember it was very important.
lines.zh: : 我不太记得那个晚上的事了，但我记得那非常重要。

lines.en: : And if you pass out on the ground and start hyperventilating {i}here?{/i} What am I supposed to do then?
lines.zh: : 那要是你{i}在这儿{/i}昏倒在地上开始过度换气呢？我该怎么办？

lines.en: : Let you freeze to death?
lines.zh: : 让你冻死吗？

lines.en: : You could always try to force me to have sex with you again. That worked really well last time.
lines.zh: : 你也可以再试着逼我跟你上床啊。上次那招效果不是好得很吗。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine17
: You-
: You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : Please don’t bring that up anymore.
lines.zh: : 求你别再提那件事了。

lines.en: : I hope you know I’m going to bring that up literally all the time now.
lines.zh: : 我希望你明白，从今往后我真的会一直一直提。

lines.en: : Does seeing me in anguish truly make you that happy?
lines.zh: : 看到我痛苦，真能让你那么开心吗？

lines.en: : Not really. But seeing you blush like that does.
lines.zh: : 倒也不是。但看到你那样脸红倒是挺开心的。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine18
: {i}*Ahem*{/i}
: Since you’re so dead set on turning your life into some sort of puzzle that must be solved, I suppose I can try to summarize at least one very important detail for you.
lines.zh: : 既然你这么铁了心要把自己的人生变成某种必须解开的谜题，那我想我至少可以试着为你概括一个非常重要的细节。

lines.en: : Without divulging too much, several things have transpired over the last several months that have forced me into an inevitable change of opinions about you.
lines.zh: : 在不泄露太多的前提下，过去这几个月里发生了好几件事，逼得我不可避免地对你的看法发生了改变。

lines.en: : I’ve been noticing it for quite some time, but my stubbornness is one of my greatest flaws, and this meant that I was unable to accept it.
lines.zh: : 我早就注意到了，但固执是我最大的缺点之一，这意味着我一直没能接受它。

lines.en: : I have told you in the past that you are “changing.”
lines.zh: : 我从前告诉过你，你在“改变”。

lines.en: : I was wrong.
lines.zh: : 我错了。

lines.en: : I have told you in the past that everything is part of a cycle.
lines.zh: : 我从前告诉过你，一切都是循环的一部分。

lines.en: : I was wrong about that as well.
lines.zh: : 那我也错了。

lines.en: : You are not changing and, with how hectic things have become lately, there is clearly no cycle at all. And if there is, it’s a really fucking stupid one without any rules.
lines.zh: : 你没有在改变，而且最近一切都乱成这样，显然也根本不存在什么循环。就算有，那也是个毫无规则的、蠢到家的循环。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine19
: The reason I don’t want you to learn any more about “your” past is precisely because it is {i}your{/i} past.
lines.zh: : 我不想让你再多了解“你的”过去，原因恰恰就在于那是{i}你的{/i}过去。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Probably?
lines.zh: : 大概？

lines.en: : Saying “definitely” too soon and then losing you would be the emotional equivalent of dropping my body feet first into a meat grinder.
lines.zh: : 太早说出“肯定”，然后又失去你，那在情感上等同于把我的身体双脚朝下丢进绞肉机。

lines.en: : So, does that mean that I'm-
lines.zh: : 那么，也就是说我是——

lines.en: : Yes.
: Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : But that still doesn’t explain-
lines.zh: : 但这还是解释不了——

lines.en: : I can’t explain anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不能再解释了。

lines.en: : Not safely at least.
lines.zh: : 至少不能安全地解释。

lines.en: : And I would really...{i}REALLY{/i} appreciate it if you’d stop looking for answers.
lines.zh: : 而且我真的……{i}真的{/i}恳求你别再寻找答案了。

lines.en: : Stay exactly where you are now- at the precipice of everything. The edge of the world...
lines.zh: : 就停在你现在这个位置——一切事物的悬崖边。世界的边缘……

lines.en: : Because the second you fall off-
lines.zh: : 因为你掉下去的那一刻——

lines.en: : I fall as well.
lines.zh: : 我也会掉下去。

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine20
: I should probably tell Ami and Ayane we’ll be coming to meet up with them soon.
lines.zh: : 我大概该告诉 Ami 和 Ayane，我们很快就过去跟她们汇合。

lines.en: : I should have done that earlier but my phone is still in one of the lockers.
lines.zh: : 我早该那么做的，可我的手机还在某个储物柜里。

lines.en: : I’ll handle it. Just go get your stuff.
lines.zh: : 我来搞定。你去拿你的东西。

lines.en: : Okay.
I start typing a message out and-
lines.zh: 我开始打字，然后——

lines.en: : Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei。

lines.en: : ...Yeah?
: If I could tell you more, I would.
lines.zh: : 如果我能告诉你更多，我会的。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Really.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : Even though I’m the most disgusting person in the world?
lines.zh: : 就算我是世界上最恶心的人？

lines.en: scene mayasnowshrine21
: Right.
: Even though you’re the most disgusting person in the world.
lines.zh: : 就算你是世界上最恶心的人。

lines.en: : I get it.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : And thanks.
lines.zh: : 还有，谢谢。

lines.en: : Now, go get your stuff.
lines.zh: : 行了，去拿你的东西吧。

lines.en: : Okay.
: I’ll be right back then...
lines.zh: : 那我马上回来……

lines.en: scene black
I finish typing out the message I was about to send to Ami and Ayane before Maya interrupted me.
lines.zh: 我把刚才打算发给 Ami 和 Ayane 的消息打完——在 Maya 打断我之前就在打的那条。

lines.en: Even after hearing all of that, though, I think she might be overreacting.
lines.zh: 不过，即便听了这些话，我还是觉得她可能反应过度了。

lines.en: It is troubling how today went down with...losing several hours and managing to aimlessly wander through a snowstorm without noticing.
lines.zh: 今天确实让人不安——丢了几个小时，还能毫无察觉地在暴风雪里漫无目的地游荡。

lines.en: But much worse things have happened much earlier on.
lines.zh: 但比这严重得多的事，早在更早的时候就发生过了。

lines.en: So chalking those lapses up to the fact that I now have someone {i}willing{/i} to tell me about the past...
lines.zh: 所以要把这些断片归结为“现在我有了个{i}愿意{/i}告诉我过去的人”……

lines.en: I don’t believe it.
lines.zh: 我不信。

lines.en: It doesn’t add up.
lines.zh: 说不通。

lines.en: And I don’t want to say Maya is hiding anything from me, but-
lines.zh: 我也不想说 Maya 在瞒着我什么，但——

lines.en: Maya is clearly hiding things from me.
lines.zh: Maya 显然在瞒着我一些事。

lines.en: : Okay...sorry.
lines.zh: : 好了……抱歉。

lines.en: : I think that’s everything.
lines.zh: : 我想就这些了。

lines.en: : Are we going back to your house?
lines.zh: : 我们要回你家吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. It looks like that’s the plan.
lines.zh: : 嗯。看来是这么安排的。

lines.en: : Okay. But we should probably hurry up.
lines.zh: : 好。不过我们大概得快点。

lines.en: : We’ve kept them waiting for quite some time and I am extremely cold right now.
lines.zh: : 我们已经让她们等了挺久，而且我现在冷得要命。

lines.en: : Want to hold hands and keep each other warm?
lines.zh: : 要不要牵着手互相取暖？

lines.en: : I would rather freeze to death.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿冻死。
